[EN] Small Revenge
[ES] Pequeña venganza
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] I'll try about anything to be rid of those Gutrends.
[ES] Intentaré cualquier cosa para librarme de esos destripadores.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Gutrends will find nothing to eat here. They'll have to move elsewhere.
[ES] Los destripadores no encontrarán nada para comer aquí. Tendrán que mudarse a otra parte.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Eliminate hillwalker warthogs and scavenging bears, the Gutrends' main source of food
[ES] Elimina a los jabalíes caminantes y osos carroñeros, la principal fuente de alimento de los destripadores.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I did my duty."
[ES] "Cumplí con mi deber."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Mirim.
[ES] Habla con Mirim.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
